title: Pass the Plate: Elle's Favorite Things
theme: Pass the Plate: Elle's Favorite Things
shortDescription: Pass the Plate: Elle's Favorite Things trivia at WesCo Brew & Bowl on November 17.
description: Get your team together at WesCo Brew & Bowl for Pass the Plate: Elle's Favorite Things, a hosted Four Dogs trivia night built around a mix of Elle's favorite topics and pop-culture picks. Pass the answers around your table and see what your team knows.
instructions: Join the free team trivia game at WesCo at 7:00 PM. Contact the venue for seating details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
